propositions: During execution-phase review, a Pass-1 finder flags a plan-vs-code discrepancy (e.g., plan directs 'remove X', code no longer contains X) as a false positive when the directed work is already complete.
Pass-2 lacks a mechanism to drop such findings, blocking valid completed tickets from closing during execution review.
A new veto drops the finding when execution_review=True, current_state_satisfies_plan_goal='yes', and the finding's criteria are in registry.CODEBASE_GROUNDED.
The veto is cohort-restricted to code-grounded verifiers (E4/G1G2/A1/G6) and enforced deterministically in the orchestrator wrapper to prevent tool-less single-turn verification from firing it.
Planning-phase reviews (execution_review=False) preserve the finding as a true positive.
The new sub-answer current_state_satisfies_plan_goal is na-default, plan-review-only, and excluded from GRADED_BINARY to avoid affecting validity arithmetic.
